component.name: Bibbia
component.summary: Read the Bible and keep your notes offline
Leggi la Bibbia e conserva i tuoi appunti offline

description.p: A native GNOME Bible reader with Italian and English translations, phrase highlights, notes, bookmarks and search. Your notes stay on your device without an account.

Includes complete Catholic Italian CEI 2008 and Martini translations, Diodati, KJV, and an extended English collection with apocrypha, 1 Enoch and Jubilees. Bible texts and fonts have separate licenses. CEI text is for educational noncommercial use under the source's terms.
Organize annotations with folders, tags and combined search filters. Reduced reading and comparison memory use, compact reference indexes and cached native text layout.
Native synchronized translation comparison and improved Windows installation metadata.
Paged book reading, responsive facing pages, native selections, opaque paper and a slower page curl.
A progressive top-corner page curl with a diagonal fold, moving shadow and translucent paper back.
Book-style reading with a curved chapter turn, paper shading and native animations that respect reduced motion.
